text: Roll No-Face with the arrow keys or WASD.
Stand upright on the swirling hole to clear the stage.
Be careful not to fall into the lake!
Scroll to zoom, press C to reset the zoom.
Red wooden bridges and switches are located in many levels.
The switches are activated when being pressed down by the block.
You don't need to stay on the switches to keep the bridges closed.
A closed bridge sinks under the water: you can still see its planks, but you cannot walk on them.
When activated, each switch may behave differently.
Some will toggle the bridges from open to closed to open.
Some will only open the bridges, pressing them again will not make them close.
There are 2 types of switches: 'Heavy' X-shaped bamboo and 'Soft' round stones carved with a cherry blossom.
Soft switches are activated when any part of your block presses them.
Heavy switches require more pressure. They are only activated when your block is standing on its end.
A switch glows while it is on.
Piles of orange leaves are more fragile than the rest of the land.
If you stand up vertically on a leaf pile, it will give way and you will fall.
There is also a 3rd kind of switch that is shaped like ( ).
It teleports you to different locations, splitting No-Face into 2 smaller pieces at the same time: the head and the body.
They can be controlled individually and will rejoin into a normal block when they touch.
You can switch control between the pieces with [Space]. The piece with a flower above it is the one you control.
Have fun!
